payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and annotations used to identify non-standard pronunciations in speech data.

claims.text: Non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations in transcriptions that include mispronunciations, poor intelligibility, and other disfluencies.
The transcription process includes labeling foreign words and deviations from standard orthography, which helps in identifying non-standard pronunciations.
The use of a generated phonetic lexicon improves the identification of non-standard pronunciations in speech recognition tasks.
